data.description:
## Context
Split out of 06e0-fb68-657a-4ea1 (effete-barbaric-xiaosaurus). `reducer` is ONE
un-annotated def away from the tier-1 typing ratchet — but that one def is not a
rubber-stamp annotation, which is why it was excluded rather than papered over.

## The problem
`rebar.reducer._filters.match_predicate(state, field, op, value)` takes `value` whose
type DEPENDS ON `op`: a scalar for `eq`/`lt`/`le`/`gt`/`ge`, an iterable for `in`, and a
`(lo, hi)` pair for `range`. Annotating it `value: object` was tried and produces 7 real
mypy errors in the body (`object` is not iterable, no `int()` overload, etc.).
`value: Any` would satisfy the ratchet while buying neither the navigability nor the
contract driver — exactly the failure mode ticket cc77-8120-bcc6-47e8 documents.

## Approach
Model the predicate properly rather than widening: e.g. an operator-tagged predicate
value (a small union / dataclass per operator family) built by the two callers
(`reducer/_query.py` and `apply_ticket_filters`), so the operator and its value shape
travel together and the body narrows by construction. Then promote `rebar.reducer.*` into
the tier-1 override in pyproject.toml and `_RATCHET_BASELINE` in
tests/unit/test_mypy_ratchet.py.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] `mypy src/rebar/reducer --disallow-untyped-defs` is clean with NO new `: Any`/`-> Any`.
- [ ] `rebar.reducer.*` is in the tier-1 override and pinned in `_RATCHET_BASELINE`.
- [ ] Filter/query behaviour is unchanged (existing reducer filter tests pass unmodified).
data.title: Give reducer._filters.match_predicate a typed predicate value so reducer can join the typing ratchet
